label: refute-t6-false-statements
tail:
### FINDING 1 — fs-local-compactness-is-hereditary — open and closed subspaces are falsely presented as exhaustive
LOCATION: Statement, lines 46–50
QUOTE: "What is true for local compactness is heredity along **open** subspaces and along **closed** subspaces of a locally compact Hausdorff space, and no more."
DEFECT: The words “and no more” falsely make the open and closed cases exhaustive. Local compactness also passes to locally closed subspaces, which may be neither open nor closed in the original ambient space.
EVIDENCE: In the usual real line, the subspace (0,1] is neither open nor closed, but it is locally compact. Points below 1 have compact closed intervals contained in the subspace as neighbourhoods, while 1 has the compact neighbourhood [1/2,1].
SEVERITY: fatal
MINIMAL REPAIR: Replace “and no more” with “but arbitrary subspaces need not inherit it”.
